column1: # mini model registry — curated 2026-07.
# Ordered best → smallest. mini picks the first row that fits the memory budget.
# id            <TAB> min_budget_mb <TAB> max_ctx <TAB> class <TAB> note
# min_budget_mb = download size plus room for a working KV cache.
# max_ctx       = the model's NATIVE context, verified with:
#                   ollama show <model> | grep 'context length'
#                 Do not inflate it. num_ctx above the architecture limit does
#                 nothing — ollama silently runs at the native size, and mini
#                 ends up reporting a context it does not have.
# Tool calling is the requirement, not benchmark scores: this agent's whole job
# is run-command → read-output → decide. A model that drops tool calls on turn
# six is worse than a smaller one that stays coherent. Verify with:
#   ollama show <model>   → Capabilities must list "tools"
# NO THINKING MODELS. Every entry here answers directly. A reasoning model burns
# its output budget on a <think> block before saying anything, which on CPU is
# minutes of latency per turn — and measured on qwen3:0.6b, it spent the entire
# budget thinking and returned EMPTY content. Prefer -instruct variants; check a
# candidate with:  ollama show <model>  → 'thinking' in Capabilities is a red
# flag unless the tag is explicitly -instruct.
